outcome_evidence: The robot approaches and aligns with the upper drawer handle in frames 0–95 (image, left_ego_image), then closes its gripper around the handle in frames 96–105 (wrist_image). The drawer visibly slides outward in frames 122–156, exposing its side and interior (image, left_ego_image). The robot releases and withdraws in frames 163–183, leaving the drawer open (all three cameras). No failed acquisition, unwanted collision, or disturbance of unrelated objects is visible.
